transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Well, I've been having trouble going to the toilet. It's been hard to pass anything, and I have to strain a lot.
When did you first notice it?
It started about three weeks ago, I think. Before that I was fine.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
Well, I've been drinking less than I used to — only about three cups of tea a day — because I don't want to keep getting up at night. I suppose that hasn't helped.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
The stools are hard and come out like little pellets, and the straining is quite uncomfortable — maybe a 4 out of 10. My lower tummy feels bloated too.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's just in my lower tummy, the bloated feeling. It doesn't really spread anywhere else.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
The straining is about a 4 out of 10. It's uncomfortable, but not terrible.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It's mostly there these days, the bloated feeling. It doesn't really let up much.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
No, nothing like that. There's no blood in my stools, nothing black, and I haven't been sick or vomiting.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I have arthritis in my spine and my knees. And I have an irregular heartbeat — atrial fibrillation, they called it.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
I take a few things. There's apixaban, and bisoprolol for my heart, and a calcium and vitamin D tablet I chew. And about a month ago the doctor started me on co-codamol for my back pain.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, I'm not allergic to anything as far as I know.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
Not really, I still get about the house. I just feel uncomfortable and bloated, that's all.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
Well, I suppose I do worry a bit. I'd like something to get things moving again, and I do wonder if it could be something serious — like bowel cancer.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
